intro: Train a short trailer read around a premise, a change, and a reveal. These six exercises use original copy to make the story turn audible without copying a famous narrator or forcing an unusually deep voice.
zhintro: 围绕设定、变化和揭示训练短预告片旁白。六项练习使用原创文本，让故事转折能够被听见；无需模仿知名配音员，也不必强迫自己压低声音。
drills: Premise in one breath
Name the place and the central problem in one comfortable phrase. Record a plain version before adding atmosphere; the listener must understand the setup.
Three reveal cards
Write a setup, an interruption, and an unanswered question on separate cards. Read them in order, giving each a clear purpose rather than equal intensity.
Turn word contrast
Choose one word where the situation changes. Record two takes with emphasis before and after that word; compare which makes the reversal easiest to follow.
Silence before the reveal
Leave a short deliberate gap before the last image. Compare it with a continuous read; keep the pause only if it adds anticipation without confusion.
Music-free take
Remove the music bed and listen again. The premise and turn must still work when no sound effect tells the audience what to feel.
Shorter second cut
Reduce the original copy by one sentence while preserving the premise, reversal, and final question. Compare clarity rather than simply speaking faster.
zhdrills: 一句建立设定
用舒适的一句交代地点与核心问题。先录平实版本再加氛围，确保听者能理解故事从哪里开始。
三张揭示卡
分别写下设定、打断与悬念，按顺序朗读。给每张卡明确目的，不要从头到尾维持同一强度。
转折词对比
选出情况发生变化的一个词，分别在它之前和之后强调，比较哪个版本更容易听懂反转。
揭示前留白
在最后一个画面前留短暂停顿，与连续朗读对比。只有增加期待且不造成混淆时才保留。
去掉音乐
关闭音乐床再回听。没有音效暗示时，设定与转折仍应成立。
缩短第二版
删掉一句但保留设定、反转与末尾问题。比较清晰度，不要只靠加速缩短。
sample: “Every night, the lighthouse sends one signal. Tonight, someone answers from the empty sea. Mara has until dawn to find the sender.” Mark the first sentence as the premise, “Tonight” as the turn, and the final deadline as the reveal. Record a neutral cut and an urgent cut at a comfortable level.
zhsample: “每晚，灯塔只发出一次信号。今晚，空荡的海面传来回应。玛拉必须在天亮前找到发送者。”第一句是设定，“今晚”是转折，最后的期限是揭示。用舒适音量分别录平实版和紧迫版。
review: A listener can name the setting, explain what changed, and recall the deadline after one hearing. The urgent take preserves every word and does not clip. Reject a cut if added growl hides consonants, if the turn sounds like another setup detail, or if removing the music makes the story incomprehensible.
zhreview: 听者一次听完后能说出地点、发生了什么变化以及期限。紧迫版保留全部文字且不削波。如果低沉质感遮住辅音、转折像普通信息，或去掉音乐后听不懂故事，就重录。
limit: Use your own trailer copy or material licensed for this purpose. This page provides performance exercises, not a trailer generator or a professional casting assessment. Keep your ordinary comfortable register; stop if a vocal effect causes discomfort.
zhlimit: 使用自己创作或获得相应用途授权的文本。本页提供表演练习，不是预告片生成器，也不是专业选角评估。保持舒适音区；声音效果引起不适时停止。

intro: Practice clear, spacious delivery for an optional guided-listening script. The task is to make each spoken invitation easy to follow, keep silence intentional, and let listeners choose whether to participate. This is narration practice with no health or sleep promise.
zhintro: 练习清楚、留有空间的引导聆听旁白。目标是让每个邀请容易理解、让留白有目的，并允许听者自行选择是否参与。本页仅训练旁白，不承诺健康或睡眠效果。
drills: Invitation wording
Read an instruction once, then rewrite it as an optional invitation. Compare whether a listener can decline without feeling they have failed the exercise.
One cue at a time
Separate observation, action, and return cues into individual sentences. Avoid introducing a new task while the previous task is still being processed.
Silence map
Mark a short space after each invitation. Read with the spaces, then review whether the next sentence feels premature or the recording seems accidentally unfinished.
Clear soft delivery
Record at ordinary conversational volume, then reduce intensity slightly without swallowing word endings. Choose the version that stays intelligible on a phone speaker.
Neutral sensory options
Offer a choice of noticing a sound, an object, or a point in the room. Do not assume every listener can visualize or close their eyes.
Return and finish
Write an explicit final line that ends the activity. Practice returning to everyday speaking pace so the listener knows the recording is complete.
zhdrills: 改成邀请
先读指令，再改为可选择的邀请。比较听者拒绝时是否仍感到被尊重，而不是认为练习失败。
一次一个提示
把观察、动作与返回提示拆成独立句子，上一项尚未消化时不要加入新的任务。
标记留白
每个邀请后标出短暂空间，回听下一句是否过早，或录音是否像意外中断。
轻柔但清楚
先用正常对话音量录音，再略减强度但保留词尾，选择手机扬声器上仍可听清的版本。
提供感官选择
可以留意声音、物件或房间中的一点，不假定每个人都能想象画面或愿意闭眼。
明确结束
写出活动结束句，并恢复日常说话节奏，让听者知道录音已经完成。
sample: “If you would like, notice one sound in the room. You may simply listen, or look at an object nearby. We will leave a little space here. When you are ready, return your attention to the room.” Record the invitation and the return at the same audible level; annotate where you leave silence.
zhsample: “如果愿意，可以留意房间里的一种声音。你可以只听，也可以看身边的一件物品。这里留出一点空间。准备好时，把注意力带回房间。”邀请与返回保持相同的可听音量，并标记留白位置。
review: Check that each invitation offers a real choice, each cue has enough space, endings remain audible, the final line clearly ends the recording, and no promise of treatment was added. Ask a listener which cue came next. If they cannot recall the sequence, simplify the wording before slowing it down further.
zhreview: 检查邀请是否真正可选、提示间是否有空间、句尾是否可听、结束是否明确以及是否添加了治疗承诺。让听者复述下一项提示；如果顺序混乱，先简化文字，再考虑放慢。
limit: This routine evaluates recording clarity only. It does not diagnose, treat, prevent, or resolve a medical or psychological condition. Listeners may skip any invitation. Do not insert breath-holding, discomfort, or compulsory eye-closing instructions.
zhlimit: 这套流程只评估录音清晰度，不诊断、治疗、预防或解决医学与心理问题。听者可以跳过任何邀请，不加入屏息、不适或强制闭眼的指令。

intro: Practice describing essential visible actions during a gap in dialogue. These drills separate observation from interpretation and test whether the listener can follow who acts, where they move, and what changes without the image. Narration must leave room for the original soundtrack.
zhintro: 练习在对白空隙中描述必要的可见动作。区分观察与解释，检验听者离开画面后是否知道谁行动、移动到哪里及发生什么变化，同时为原有声音留下空间。
drills: Silent clip inventory
Use a short clip you own and list only visible actions. Separate a camera-observable fact from a guess about a character’s motives.
Priority selection
Choose the two visual facts needed to understand the next story beat. Leave decorative details out if they displace information about an action or its result.
Dialogue gap mapping
Write down where speech and meaningful sound occur. Place your description in an actual gap rather than talking over dialogue to fit more words.
Name before action
Introduce the subject before the verb when the actor could be ambiguous. Keep a consistent name for each person, object, and location.
Concrete verb rewrite
Replace inferred emotions with observable movements. Compare “is furious” with a visible action such as “pushes the chair back,” without pretending the two are identical.
Audio-only check
Play the description with the original sound while hiding the picture. Ask someone to recount the action; revise any detail they misunderstand or cannot place.
zhdrills: 无声画面清单
使用自己拥有的短片，只列可见动作，把镜头能观察到的事实与对动机的猜测分开。
筛选关键事实
选出理解下一步剧情所需的两项画面信息，不让装饰细节挤掉动作与结果。
标记对白空隙
记下说话和有意义的声音出现在哪里，只把描述放进真实空隙，不压住对白强塞文字。
先交代主体
动作执行者可能不清楚时先说主体，同一人物、物件和地点始终使用一致名称。
换成具体动词
把推测情绪换成可观察动作，例如“推开椅子”。这与“很愤怒”并不具有同样含义。
只听声音复查
隐藏画面，播放描述与原声，让他人复述动作；修改误解或无法定位的信息。
sample: Imagine a clip with a three-second silent gap: Lena slides a blue envelope under a locked door, then walks away. Try “Lena slips a blue envelope under the door.” Compare it with “Lena secretly betrays her friend.” The second line invents a motive the pictured action cannot establish.
zhsample: 想象一段有三秒空隙的画面：莉娜把蓝色信封从锁着的门下推进去，然后离开。尝试“莉娜把蓝色信封塞进门下”，对比“莉娜秘密背叛朋友”。后一句虚构了画面不能证明的动机。
review: Pass when the listener identifies the actor, action, important object, and result without losing dialogue. Time the take against the actual available gap. A fluent sentence still fails if it overlaps speech or adds an unobservable motive. Keep a revision note explaining what you removed and why it was unnecessary.
zhreview: 听者能识别人物、动作、关键物件及结果，且没有漏掉对白，才算通过。用真实空隙计时；句子再流畅，覆盖对白或添加不可见动机也算失败。记录删掉了什么及理由。
limit: This is introductory practice, not a certified accessibility evaluation. Use an owned or authorized clip, and seek feedback from intended listeners for production work. Description cannot replace missing dialogue, captions, or other access services.
zhlimit: 这是入门练习，不是获得认证的无障碍评估。使用自有或获授权画面，正式制作时向目标听众征求反馈。音频描述不能替代缺失的对白、字幕或其他无障碍服务。

zh: IVR 语音菜单配音练习
intro: Practice phone-menu prompts that let a caller choose the correct route after one hearing. The drills focus on option numbering, label consistency, manageable lists, and recoverable errors. This is a recorded menu task rather than a conversational voicemail greeting.
zhintro: 练习让来电者一次听完就能选择正确路径的电话菜单。重点是选项编号、一致名称、适当列表长度和可恢复的错误提示；这是录制菜单任务，与个人留言问候不同。
drills: Destination map
Draw a small menu with three destinations before recording. Check that every spoken option leads to the destination shown in the brief.
Label and number pairs
Record each option as one unit. Compare label-first and number-first versions, then use one approved pattern consistently throughout the menu.
List spacing
Read the entire list without music. Leave a distinct separation between options while keeping each destination and its number together.
Repeat route
Write and record a repeat instruction. Test whether a caller who missed the second option knows how to hear the menu again.
Invalid-choice recovery
Record a neutral error message that repeats available choices. Do not blame the caller or imply that an unavailable service can be reached.
Telephone playback
Listen on an ordinary phone speaker at a normal level. Ask another person to write down the options and numbers without seeing the script.
zhdrills: 画出路径
录音前画出有三个目的地的小菜单，检查每个口述选项都指向简报中的正确路径。
名称编号成对
把选项名称和数字作为一组录制，对比先名称与先数字，整套菜单使用一个已批准的规则。
列表间隔
不用音乐朗读完整列表，选项之间留清楚间隔，名称和数字则保持在一起。
重听路径
写出重听指令，检验漏听第二项的人是否知道如何再次播放。
错误选择恢复
中性地说明无效选择并重述可用路径，不责怪来电者，也不暗示不存在的服务。
电话回听
用普通手机扬声器和正常音量听，让他人不看文字写下选项与数字。
sample: “For appointment times, press one. For an existing booking, press two. To hear these options again, press three.” Now add an invalid-choice prompt: “That option is not available. Please choose one, two, or three.” This fictional menu is a practice brief; it does not represent a connected telephone service.
zhsample: “查询预约时间，请按一。查询已有预约，请按二。重新收听选项，请按三。”再加错误提示：“该选项暂不可用，请选择一、二或三。”这是虚构的练习简报，不代表真实接入的电话服务。
review: The listener writes down all three correct label-number pairs and can identify the repeat option. The error prompt must point back to an available choice. A pleasant voice fails the exercise if a number is unclear, a destination changes its name, or the recorded list disagrees with the menu map.
zhreview: 听者应写对三组名称与数字，并认出重听选项。错误提示必须返回可用路径。即使音色亲切，数字听不清、目的地改名或录音与路径图不一致也不能通过。
limit: Confirm route labels and key assignments with the menu owner before production. This page does not connect calls or install an IVR system. Never promise a response time, emergency service, or department that the real system does not provide.
zhlimit: 正式录音前向菜单负责人确认名称与按键。本页不转接电话，也不安装 IVR 系统。不承诺实际系统未提供的响应时间、紧急服务或部门。

intro: Build a brief voicemail greeting that identifies the right recipient, explains what the caller can leave, and ends clearly. Practice ordinary, temporary-away, and corrected versions without inventing availability or collecting unnecessary personal information.
zhintro: 训练简短的语音信箱问候，让来电者确认接收者、了解可以留下什么并听清结束。练习日常、临时离开和修正版，不虚构可用时间，也不收集不必要的个人信息。
drills: Identity first
Say the approved person or business name before giving instructions. Ask a listener whether they know whom they have reached from the opening alone.
Availability boundary
Write one honest sentence about being unable to answer. Leave out a callback deadline unless it is a real commitment approved by the owner.
Minimum message request
Ask for a callback number and a brief reason only when necessary. Avoid requesting passwords, payment details, or sensitive case information in the greeting.
Temporary-away version
Record a version with a verified return date or an approved alternative contact. Check that the message has an owner responsible for replacing it.
End-of-greeting cue
Finish the sentence before the recording tone. Compare a complete ending with one that rushes or trails off so callers miss when to begin.
Misheard-name repair
Ask someone to transcribe the greeting. If the name or number is wrong, slow that phrase slightly and record again rather than raising overall volume.
zhdrills: 先说明身份
指令前读出已批准的人名或商号，让听者仅凭开场就知道自己联系了谁。
明确可用边界
用一句真实说明无法接听；除非负责人确实承诺，不给回电期限。
只请求必要信息
需要时请求回电号码与简短事由，不要求密码、支付详情或敏感案件信息。
临时离开版本
使用核验后的返回日期或批准的替代联系人，并确认谁负责及时替换问候。
完整结束提示
在录音提示音前说完句子，对比完整结尾与匆忙、消失的词尾。
修正误听名称
让他人转写问候；名称或号码有误时，只略慢读该段重录，不提高全段音量。
sample: “You have reached Rowan at West Lane Studio. I cannot answer right now. Please leave a callback number and a brief reason for your call after the tone.” Record a second version for a fictional temporary closure, clearly marking the date as practice information rather than a real public notice.
zhsample: “这里是西巷工作室的罗文，现在无法接听。请在提示音后留下回电号码和简短来电事由。”再录一个虚构临时休息版本，日期标为练习信息，不作为真实公告使用。
review: Listen once and check the recipient, availability statement, message request, complete ending, and absence of an unsupported promise. A caller should not have to replay the greeting to find out whether it belongs to the correct business. Reject any version that includes a guessed date or unnecessary sensitive-data request.
zhreview: 一次回听，检查接收者、可用说明、留言请求、完整结尾和无未经支持的承诺。来电者不应靠重听确认联系对象。含猜测日期或多余敏感信息请求的版本应重录。
limit: This page supplies practice wording and delivery checks, not a voicemail hosting service. Verify names, dates, numbers, and alternative contacts before using a greeting. Do not publish personal contact information merely to complete the exercise.
zhlimit: 本页提供练习文字与表达检查，不托管语音信箱。实际使用前核验名称、日期、号码与替代联系人。不为完成练习而公开私人联系方式。

intro: Guide a visitor from an object they can find to a detail they can observe and a fact the exhibit supports. The routine tests looking time, directional clarity, and separation of verified interpretation from speculation. It is object-led narration rather than a general documentary read.
zhintro: 引导参观者先找到展品，再观察细节，最后理解有依据的事实。训练观察时间、方向表达及已核验解释与猜测的区分；这是围绕具体展品的旁白，不是泛纪录片朗读。
drills: Locate the object
Describe an unambiguous exhibit label or visible landmark. Check the description against the visitor’s position rather than assuming they face the same direction as you.
Observe before explaining
Invite the visitor to notice one visible detail before describing its meaning. Keep the observation and the interpretation in separate sentences.
Fact-source marking
Mark every date, attribution, material, and historical claim with its approved source. Read uncertainty explicitly when the exhibit does not establish a single answer.
Looking-time pass
Leave time for a visitor to find the detail. Record a version that rushes and another that allows looking, then test them beside the object.
Pronunciation approval
Make a short list of names and specialist terms. Resolve pronunciations with the exhibit owner instead of guessing a confident version during recording.
Next-stop handoff
End with the next action or stop identifier. Test whether someone can follow it without walking back or losing their place in the guide.
zhdrills: 定位展品
使用明确标签或可见地标，从访客位置核验，不假定对方与你朝向相同。
先观察后解释
先邀请观察一个可见细节，再解释含义，观察与解读使用独立句子。
标记事实来源
为日期、归属、材料与历史主张标注批准来源；不确定时明确说明，不能装作唯一答案。
留出观看时间
录一个匆忙版和一个留时间找细节的版本，在展品旁检验。
确认读音
列出人名与专门术语，向展方核实读音，不在录音中自信猜测。
交接下一站
以明确的下一步或站点编号结束，检验他人是否能继续而不用走回头路。
sample: Use a fictional exhibit card: “Study bowl, maker unknown, practice object.” Read: “Find the shallow bowl marked A. Notice the three grooves near the rim. The maker is unknown. When you are ready, continue to practice stop B.” No historical date or origin is supplied, so the narrator must not invent one.
zhsample: 使用虚构展签：“习作碗，制作者未知，练习物件。”朗读：“找到标为 A 的浅碗，观察口沿附近三道凹槽。制作者未知。准备好后，前往练习站 B。”展签未给年代或产地，因此旁白不能编造。
review: Pass when a visitor locates the correct object, finds the stated detail, distinguishes facts from unknowns, hears approved names clearly, and knows the next stop. Reject a fluent take if it adds provenance absent from the card. Note the moment a listener needed more viewing time and adjust that pause only.
zhreview: 访客能定位正确展品、找到细节、区分事实与未知、听清核验名称并知道下一站才通过。流畅版本若添加展签没有的来源，也要重录。只调整听者确实需要更多观察时间的位置。
limit: Production copy requires curatorial approval and feedback from intended visitors. This practice card is fictional and carries no museum attribution. Directional instructions must be checked on site; they cannot establish that a route is accessible or safe.
zhlimit: 正式文字须经策展方批准，并听取目标访客反馈。这张练习展签是虚构的，不归属于任何博物馆。方向指令须实地核验，不能由此证明路线无障碍或安全。

intro: Practice an intelligible bulletin while preserving attribution, numbers, and uncertainty. The exercises teach an approved script as information, with clearly separated headlines and corrections. They do not turn fictional practice copy into reporting or authorize changes to facts.
zhintro: 练习清晰播读，同时保留来源、数字与不确定性。用已批准文字训练信息表达、清楚区分标题与更正，不把虚构练习稿变成报道，也不擅自修改事实。
drills: Source labels
Underline who said each claim. Record the attribution with enough emphasis that the audience does not mistake a statement for an independently verified fact.
Headline and detail
Read a headline, leave a small separation, then deliver supporting detail. Ask a listener whether they hear one item or two unrelated stories.
Number grouping
Mark units beside each number. Read amount and unit together, then check a transcript against the approved script instead of trusting memory.
Uncertainty preservation
Circle “estimated,” “reported,” and other qualifications. Record them at the same clear level as the claim rather than rushing through them.
Correction practice
Write an explicit correction naming the earlier error and the correct value. Avoid vague wording that leaves listeners unsure which information changed.
Cold bulletin check
Give an unseen approved practice bulletin to a partner. Compare their written facts with the source after one hearing and repair only misunderstood phrases.
zhdrills: 突出来源
标出每项主张是谁说的，读清归属，避免听者误认为已经独立核实。
标题与细节
标题后略留间隔再读细节，检验听者是否听成一条新闻，而非两个无关故事。
数字和单位
数字旁标出单位，成组读出，并对照批准稿检查转写，不靠记忆。
保留不确定性
圈出“估计”“据称”等限定，与主张同样读清，不匆忙带过。
练习更正
明确说出原错误与正确值，不用让听者不知哪里改了的含糊表达。
陌生稿复查
向同伴读未见过的练习简报，让其一次听后写下事实，只修正误解处。
sample: Fictional practice bulletin: “The organizers say the exhibition will open at ten on Saturday. Attendance is estimated at three hundred visitors. Correction: the earlier practice script gave an opening time of nine; the approved time is ten.” Keep “say,” “estimated,” and the correction audible. Do not post this as a real event announcement.
zhsample: 虚构简报：“主办方说，展览将在周六十点开放。预计有三百位访客。更正：此前练习稿写九点，批准时间为十点。”读清“说”“预计”与更正，不作为真实活动公告发布。
review: The listener recalls the event, time, source, qualified attendance estimate, and corrected value. A polished take fails if it drops attribution, changes a unit, or makes an estimate sound certain. Read back numbers separately after the expressive pass; preserve the script version so the correction can be traced.
zhreview: 听者能记住事件、时间、来源、带限定的人数估计及更正值。删除归属、改变单位或把估计读成确定事实均失败。表演版后独立复核数字，保留稿件版本以便追溯。
limit: Use original fictional bulletins or scripts you are authorized to record. This page provides delivery drills, not journalism verification. Editorial approval controls factual changes; dramatic emphasis must never create a claim absent from the approved script.
zhlimit: 使用原创虚构简报或获授权稿件。本页训练播读，不核实新闻。事实修改须经编辑批准，戏剧重音不能制造批准稿没有的主张。

intro: Coordinate a puppet’s visible speaking movement with an original character line. These exercises connect voice starts, mouth openings, silent listening, and operator handoffs. They are for puppet performance coordination, with a repeatable comfortable voice rather than exaggerated strain.
zhintro: 把木偶可见的说话动作与原创台词协调起来。练习声音起点、张嘴、无声倾听和操作者交接，建立舒适、可重复的声音，而不是用力夸张。
drills: Silent mouth pass
Move the puppet through a short silent sentence. Mark opening and closing points before adding voice so you can see which gestures imply speech.
Sound-start alignment
Record one sentence while opening the mouth at the first spoken sound. Compare video and audio for an early opening or delayed voice.
Phrase openings
Use small coordinated movements through a phrase instead of opening on every letter. Test whether the motion looks readable at the audience’s distance.
Listening stillness
Perform the puppet listening to a partner without moving its mouth as if speaking. Let gaze and posture carry the reaction while the voice stays silent.
Voice recipe
Choose one comfortable rhythm and one articulation choice for the character. Repeat the line after a break to check that the recipe is recoverable.
Operator cue handoff
Agree a visible or spoken cue with a separate operator. Run one missed-cue rehearsal and practice restarting the phrase without pretending the mismatch did not occur.
zhdrills: 无声口型
先做一段无声句子的动作，标出开合点，再加声音，观察哪些动作意味着说话。
对齐发声起点
第一个声音出现时张嘴，录下画面与音频，对比提前张嘴或延迟发声。
按短语开合
在短语中用小幅协调动作，不按每个字母张嘴，在观众距离检验是否易读。
倾听时不说话
木偶倾听搭档时别让嘴像在说话，用视线和姿态反应，声音保持安静。
固定声音配方
选一种舒适节奏和一种吐字方式，休息后重复台词，检验能否找回。
操作者交接
与另一操作者约定提示，练一次漏提示后的重启，不假装失配没有发生。
sample: Original puppet exchange: Pipp asks, “Is that my hat?” The partner replies, “Only if your hat can whistle.” Pipp listens silently, looks at the hat, then says, “Then I should teach it a song.” Film the exchange once with Pipp’s listening mouth still and once with accidental talking motion; compare readability.
zhsample: 原创对话：皮普问“那是我的帽子吗？”搭档说“如果你的帽子会吹口哨，就是。”皮普安静倾听，看向帽子，然后说“那我该教它唱歌。”分别拍嘴保持安静与意外说话动作的版本，比较可读性。
review: Check that the mouth opens with the first sound, stops at the final sound, stays quiet during listening, expresses the intended reaction, and repeats the same voice recipe. A funny sound is insufficient if the puppet seems to speak over its partner. Review the video muted once to isolate gesture problems.
zhreview: 检查首尾声音与开合一致、倾听时嘴安静、反应符合意图且声音配方可复现。如果木偶像在搭档说话时抢话，搞笑音色也不能通过。关掉声音再看一次，单独识别动作问题。
limit: Use an original puppet character or one you have permission to perform. Keep the operator’s posture comfortable and stop uncomfortable vocal effects. The browser game offers general voice imitation practice; it does not evaluate puppet mouth synchronization.
zhlimit: 使用原创或获许可的木偶角色。操作者保持舒适姿势，停止引起不适的声音效果。浏览器游戏可做一般模仿练习，但不评估木偶口型同步。

intro: Practice telling an original short story to a live listener rather than narrating every written sentence. Build clear event order, notice listener confusion, and shorten a retelling without losing its cause and consequence. The focus is adaptable oral storytelling, not an audiobook production read.
zhintro: 向现场听众讲原创短故事，而不是逐句读稿。建立清楚顺序、观察听众困惑，并在保留因果的情况下缩短复述；重点是可调整的口头讲述，不是有声书录制。
drills: Three-event spine
Write a beginning, a disruption, and an outcome as three notes. Tell the story from those notes without adding a new event just to fill time.
Listener location
Introduce each new place before moving the action there. Ask the listener to point out when they no longer knew where the story was happening.
Cause bridge
Connect the disruption to the character’s choice with a concrete “because.” Compare with a version that merely lists events without explaining the decision.
Listener question pause
Leave a natural point for one question. Answer briefly and return to the event you had reached instead of restarting the entire story.
Two-length retelling
Tell the same story in a longer and a shorter version. Preserve the three-event spine and remove only details that do not change the outcome.
Recall check
Ask the listener to retell the cause and result. Use their missing or altered detail to choose one revision rather than assuming louder delivery will help.
zhdrills: 三事件主线
写开端、打断与结果三条笔记，按笔记讲，不为凑时间加入新事件。
交代位置
行动转移到新地点前先介绍，让听者指出何时不再知道故事发生在哪里。
连接因果
用具体的“因为”连接问题与角色选择，对比只堆事件、没解释决定的版本。
留一个提问点
在自然位置允许一个问题，简短回答后回到当前事件，不重讲整段。
两个长度版本
讲长短两版，保留三事件主线，只删除不会改变结果的细节。
复述检验
让听者复述原因与结果，用遗漏或变化选一项修改，不假定提高音量就能解决。
sample: Original story spine: Inez finds a folded map in the library; rain erases the shortcut; she follows the street signs and reaches the meeting late. Tell it without a script, then answer “Why did she abandon the map?” The revised version should make the rain-to-decision connection clear before the question is asked.
zhsample: 原创主线：伊内兹在图书馆发现折好的地图；雨水冲掉捷径标记；她沿路牌走，迟到才抵达会面。脱稿讲完，回答“为什么放弃地图？”修正版应在被问之前就交代雨水与决定的关系。
review: Pass when the listener recalls the beginning, disruption, choice, consequence, and final outcome. The shorter retelling must preserve the same causal chain. Reject a version that introduces unexplained travel or changes the ending to sound more impressive. One clear listener question is useful evidence of where the story needs repair.
zhreview: 听者能回忆开端、打断、选择、后果与结果才通过。短版应保留相同因果链。无解释的转场或为显得精彩而改变结局应修正；听众具体提问能指出该修哪里。
limit: Use invented stories or personal experiences you can share without disclosing someone else’s private information. This is a practice framework, not a guarantee of audience engagement. Do not manufacture a personal experience or audience testimonial.
zhlimit: 使用虚构故事或可以分享的经历，不披露他人隐私。这是练习框架，不保证观众投入，也不捏造个人经验或听众评价。

intro: Read an original poem while balancing sentence meaning, line endings, rhythm, and silence. The exercises compare different interpretations without assuming every printed line requires a pause or that one reading is the only correct version.
zhintro: 朗读原创诗歌，平衡句义、行尾、节奏与留白。对比不同解释，不假定每个印刷行尾都必须停顿，也不把一种读法认定为唯一正确版本。
drills: Sentence map
Mark where each sentence ends before reading the poem. Follow the grammar once without adding a pause solely because a printed line ends.
Line-break contrast
Read one passage with line-end pauses, then read it by sentence meaning. Compare what each version emphasizes and where an unwanted ambiguity appears.
Stress pattern
Underline the words carrying the main image. Read with only those stresses first, then restore the full text without making every word equally heavy.
Image progression
Name the image in each section privately before recording. Let the change of image guide a small shift in delivery rather than inventing a dramatic emotion.
Silence experiment
Try a pause before and after the final image. Keep the version that supports the intended reading without hiding a necessary grammatical connection.
Text accuracy pass
Check every word against the original after the expressive take. Keep interpretation notes separate from edits so a delivery choice does not silently rewrite the poem.
zhdrills: 画出句子
先标句子结束位置，按语法读一遍，不仅因为印刷行结束就停。
行尾对比
分别按行尾与句义停顿，比较重心变化及哪处产生非预期歧义。
重音模式
标出承载主要意象的词，先只读这些重音，再恢复全诗，不让每词一样重。
意象推进
录音前在心中为每段命名，让画面变化引导小幅表达转向，不凭空添加戏剧情绪。
留白实验
在末尾意象前后分别停顿，选择支持解释又不拆断必要语法关系的版本。
文字准确复查
表演后逐词核对原文，解释笔记与修改分开，避免读法偷偷改写诗。
sample: Original four-line poem: “A cup waits on the sill / while rain redraws the street. / I leave the window open; / the room remembers heat.” First read by sentence punctuation. Then test a stronger break after “sill.” Record which connection changes, and preserve the exact wording in both versions.
zhsample: 原创四行诗：“杯子等在窗台／雨重画街道。／我留着开窗；／房间记得温度。”先按句子标点读，再测试“窗台”后的更强停顿。记录哪处连接发生变化，两版保留相同原文。
review: Check exact words, intelligible syntax, deliberate line-break choices, a recognizable image progression, and a final silence with a purpose. A musical reading fails if the listener cannot follow the sentence. There is no single automatic score for interpretation; explain the intended meaning and compare whether the delivery supports it.
zhreview: 检查原词、可懂句法、有目的的行尾选择、清楚的意象推进及有作用的末尾留白。音乐感再强，听不懂句子也算失败。解释没有自动唯一分数，应先说明读法再判断表达是否支持。
limit: The practice poem here is original. For another poem, verify permission or public-domain status for the relevant use and jurisdiction. Do not claim to reproduce the author’s voice or present an interpretation as an authoritative literary judgment.
zhlimit: 本页练习诗为原创。使用其他诗歌前核验对应地区与用途的许可或公版状态。不声称还原作者声音，也不把一种解释当作权威文学结论。

intro: Identify microphone thumps caused by air bursts on plosive sounds using controlled recordings. Change one recording variable at a time and compare the same spoken line. This is microphone craft rather than a reason to remove consonants from speech.
zhintro: 通过控制录音识别爆破辅音气流带来的麦克风低频冲击。每次只改变一个录音变量，用同一句对比；这是录音工艺，不要求把辅音从语言中删除。
drills: Baseline phrase
Record the original test phrase at a comfortable speaking level with the microphone position noted. Listen for low thumps separately from ordinary consonant sounds.
Angle comparison
Move the microphone slightly off the direct air path while keeping distance stable. Record again and compare whether clarity remains while thumps decrease.
Distance comparison
Keep the new angle and test a modest increase in distance. Adjust listening volume for comparison rather than treating a quieter take as automatically cleaner.
Pop-filter check
If a filter is available, compare recordings with and without it at stable placement. Ensure it does not obscure the view of the script or encourage awkward posture.
Consonant-preserving read
Say the phrase clearly without pushing extra air for emphasis. Compare with the baseline and reject versions that replace distinct consonants with vague syllables.
Full-line verification
Put the difficult phrase into a complete sentence. Check that the chosen microphone setup also handles surrounding words and does not introduce room noise or inconsistent level.
zhdrills: 录基准句
在舒适音量下录原创测试句，记下麦克风位置，分别辨认低频冲击与正常辅音。
角度对比
距离不变，麦克风稍离直吹气流路径，再比较吐字是否保留且冲击减少。
距离对比
角度不变，小幅增加距离，调整回放音量公平比较，不能把更小声自动当更干净。
防喷罩检验
有防喷罩时固定位置做有无对照，确认不遮稿，也不引导不舒适姿势。
保留辅音
不额外喷气强调，清楚读测试句，对比基准；辅音变模糊的版本不能采用。
放回完整句
把难点放进整句，检验新位置能否处理前后文字，是否增加环境声或音量不稳。
sample: Original test line: “Pip packed a blue paper bag beside the back porch.” Record baseline A and off-axis B, label the distance and angle, and compare them at similar playback loudness. A useful result reduces low air thumps while keeping “packed,” “paper,” and “back” distinct.
zhsample: 原创测试句：“皮皮把蓝色纸袋摆在后门边。”录基准 A 和偏轴 B，标记距离角度，用相近回放响度对比。有效结果应减少低频气流冲击，同时保留每个辅音的辨识度。
review: Pass when the difficult words stay intelligible, low thumps are reduced, recording level remains usable, posture is comfortable, and the change survives a full sentence. Reject a comparison made at dramatically different playback volumes. Keep the unprocessed files so a noise-removal effect cannot hide the actual recording difference.
zhreview: 词语仍可懂、低频冲击减少、录音电平可用、姿势舒适且整句仍成立才通过。回放音量差异很大的对照不有效。保留未处理录音，避免降噪效果掩盖真实录音差别。
limit: Do not whisper, force breath, or push through discomfort to pass a recording test. This page does not diagnose a speech or voice condition. If a setup change creates more noise or poorer clarity, return to the recorded baseline and try one smaller adjustment.
zhlimit: 不靠耳语、强迫呼吸或忍受不适通过测试。本页不诊断语言或声音问题。设置改变若增加噪声或降低清晰度，回到基准再做更小的单项调整。

intro: Compare sharp sibilant sounds with matched recordings before applying processing. Keep words intelligible while testing microphone angle, distance, and playback conditions. The goal is an evidence-based recording adjustment, with a clear distinction between sound texture and speech correction.
zhintro: 使用匹配录音对比尖锐齿音，再决定是否处理。测试角度、距离与回放条件，同时保留文字可懂度。目标是有依据的录音调整，明确区别声音质感与语言矫正。
drills: Unprocessed baseline
Record the same short line without a de-esser or noise effect. Mark which words sound unusually sharp and the listening device used for that judgment.
Angle-only pass
Change microphone angle slightly while keeping other variables stable. Compare the sharp words and check whether ordinary vowels have become duller.
Distance-only pass
Return to a known angle and test a small distance change. Match playback loudness before deciding that a softer take has less sibilance.
Device comparison
Listen on headphones and a second ordinary speaker. Note whether the problem appears on both instead of treating one bright listening device as universal evidence.
Gentle processing trial
If your editor offers a de-esser, make a conservative processed copy and keep the original. Reject settings that make words lisp or lose detail.
Whole-paragraph check
Read a full original paragraph with the chosen setup. Confirm that a setting which improves one test word does not make the rest of the narration unclear.
zhdrills: 未处理基准
不用齿音器或降噪录同一句，标记异常尖锐的词以及用于判断的回放设备。
只改角度
略调角度，其他变量保持不变，比较尖锐词，同时检查元音是否变得暗闷。
只改距离
回到已知角度，小幅改变距离，匹配响度后再判断，不把更小声当更少齿音。
设备对照
用耳机和另一普通扬声器回听，记录是否两者都出现问题，不把单个偏亮设备当通用证据。
轻度处理试验
编辑器有齿音器时保守处理副本，保留原件；造成含混或细节丢失的设置应放弃。
整段复查
用选定设置读原创段落，确认改善一个测试词的设置没有伤害其他句子清晰度。
sample: Original line: “Sasha sees six silver signs beside the station.” Compare untouched A with a small angle-change B. Then place it in a paragraph: “The signs point toward the east entrance. Sasha checks the map and walks on.” Listen for sharpness and for any lost consonants in both sentences.
zhsample: 原创句：“莎莎寻找车站旁六块闪亮标识。”对比未处理 A 与略调角度 B，再放进段落：“标识指向东侧入口，莎莎核对地图后继续走。”同时听尖锐感与两句中丢失的辅音。
review: Check intelligibility, matched playback level, improvement on more than one device, absence of obvious processing damage, and stable results in the longer read. Reject a processed version that sounds smooth only because it erased consonants. Record the chosen position and settings so you can reproduce the comparison later.
zhreview: 检查可懂度、匹配响度、多设备改善、无明显处理损伤以及长段稳定。若平滑只是因为删掉了辅音，就不能采用。记录位置与设置，让以后可以重做对照。
limit: This page concerns recording and playback, not diagnosis or treatment of speech. Natural sibilants are part of words. Do not force tongue or jaw positions, and stop if any exercise is uncomfortable. Processing is optional and should not replace a controlled recording comparison.
zhlimit: 本页讨论录音与回放，不诊断或治疗语言问题。自然齿音是文字的一部分，不强迫舌头或下颌位置，不适即停止。处理是可选步骤，不能替代控制录音对照。

intro: Record a replacement sentence that fits an earlier take without changing the surrounding performance. These drills focus on reference listening, room and microphone notes, lead-in context, and edit continuity. This is unsynchronized narration pickup work rather than ADR lip matching.
zhintro: 补录一句，让它融入先前录音而不改变周围表演。重点是参考回听、房间与麦克风记录、前导语境及剪辑连续性；这是非画面对口型的旁白补录，与 ADR 同步不同。
drills: Session snapshot
Write down microphone position, gain, room conditions, and script version after a short baseline read. Use the notes to recreate a later session without guessing.
Reference listen
Hear the sentence before and after the replacement location. Describe the existing pace, energy, and ending before you record a new line.
Context lead-in
Read the preceding phrase aloud before the pickup, then continue beyond it. The extra context helps the replacement begin from the same thought rather than an isolated start.
Two matched options
Record two controlled alternatives with identical words. Change only one delivery detail so the editor has a useful choice rather than unrelated performances.
Room-sound bridge
Capture a short quiet room sample under the same settings. Listen for a change in background sound at the intended splice, keeping the original take available.
Edited continuity check
Listen to the combined passage without watching the waveform. Mark any audible join, changed pronunciation, or shifted intent and redo only the relevant pickup.
zhdrills: 记录会话
基准读完记下位置、增益、房间条件与稿件版本，以便后续还原，不靠猜测。
回听参考
听替换位置前后句，先描述原节奏、能量与结尾，再录新句。
带前导语境
补录前先读上一短语，之后继续，让替换句从同一思想出发，而非孤立起音。
两个匹配选项
相同文字录两个受控版本，只改一处表达，给编辑有用选择而不是无关表演。
环境声桥接
相同设置录短暂安静房间声，检查接缝处背景差异并保留原始录音。
合并回听
不看波形听拼接段，标记可听接缝、读音变化或意图偏移，只重做相关补录。
sample: Baseline: “The blue folder contains the morning schedule. Bring it to the desk before the meeting begins.” Replace only “morning” with “revised” after a fictional script approval. Record the whole first sentence with the second as context, then listen to the approved replacement joined to the untouched second sentence.
zhsample: 基准：“蓝色文件夹里是上午日程，开会前请把它带到桌上。”虚构批准后只把“上午”改为“修订后”。补录完整首句并带后句语境，再将批准替换与未改后句拼接回听。
review: Check exact approved words, matching microphone tone, matching room sound, continuous sentence intent, and a clean edit that preserves natural spacing. A replacement fails if it fixes the word but sounds like a new speaker or room. Label take numbers and the approved script version rather than silently overwriting the original.
zhreview: 检查批准文字、麦克风音色、环境声、句意连续以及自然间距。换对了词却像换了说话者或房间，也算失败。标注录音编号和批准版本，不偷偷覆盖原件。
limit: This guide does not edit or upload your recordings. Use an editor you control and keep the source take. Factual changes require approval from the script owner; a performer should not create a replacement claim merely to make an edit sound smooth.
zhlimit: 本指南不编辑或上传录音。使用自己控制的编辑器并保留源录音。事实变动须由稿件负责人批准，不能为剪辑顺滑而制造替代主张。

intro: Practice addressing a live group with clear meeting points, verified descriptions, and time for questions. The drills adapt to people moving and listening in a shared space. They differ from a prerecorded museum audio guide by testing live attention checks and recoverable instructions.
zhintro: 练习面向现场团队清楚表达集合点、已核验描述和提问空间。适应人在公共空间移动与聆听；区别于预录博物馆导览，重点是现场注意检查和可恢复指令。
drills: Gather before speaking
Practice a brief attention cue and wait for the group to settle before giving the main instruction. Do not compete with ongoing movement by shouting.
Meeting-point clarity
Name an observable agreed landmark and the approved return time. Ask a listener to repeat both before assuming the instruction was understood.
Fact and anecdote
Separate a verified description from an illustrative fictional story. Make the distinction audible instead of allowing an entertaining anecdote to sound like documented history.
Group-size adaptation
Read the same description to a nearby listener and a larger practice group at a comfortable level. Use positioning or suitable amplification rather than forcing volume.
Question recovery
Take one question, answer only what you can establish, and state when a fact needs checking. Return the group to the current stop without inventing certainty.
Next-action confirmation
End with one clear next action. Ask a partner to explain where the group goes next; rewrite any direction that depends on your private point of view.
zhdrills: 先集合再说
练一个简短注意提示，等团队停稳再给主指令，不靠喊叫与移动竞争。
集合点清楚
说出约定可见地标和批准返回时间，让听者复述后再确认理解。
事实与故事
把核验描述与虚构说明故事分开，明确读出区别，不让有趣故事像史实。
适应团队规模
向近处听者和较大练习团队读同一描述，借助站位或合适扩音，不强迫音量。
问题恢复
只回答能证实的内容，需核查时直说，再回到当前站点，不虚构确定性。
确认下一步
以一个明确动作结束，让同伴说明团队下一站；改掉依赖自己视角的方向。
sample: Fictional rehearsal: “Our practice meeting point is the blue sign beside this entrance. We regroup here at two. Before we move, can someone repeat the meeting point and time?” Give the line to a stationary practice group, then test a direction to a second landmark visible from their position.
zhsample: 虚构演练：“练习集合点是入口旁蓝色标牌，两点在这里重新集合。出发前，谁能复述集合点和时间？”对静止团队练习，再从听者所在位置测试到第二个可见地标的指令。
review: The group can repeat the meeting point, time, key verified fact, next action, and unanswered question that requires follow-up. A confident description fails if it depends on ambiguous “over there” instructions. Use a real rehearsal location to test audibility; do not infer that a loud recording proves a route is safe.
zhreview: 团队能复述集合点、时间、关键核验事实、下一步及待核实问题才通过。依赖“那边”等模糊指向的表达应修正。实地演练可检验可听度，音量大不能证明路线安全。
limit: Check access, timing, and site instructions with the venue owner before a real tour. This page trains communication, not crowd safety or emergency procedure. Keep vocal effort comfortable; use approved amplification when the situation requires it.
zhlimit: 真实导览前向场地负责人核验通行、时间与规定。本页训练沟通，不提供人群安全或紧急程序。发声保持舒适，需要时使用批准的扩音设施。

intro: Make a one-sided fictional phone conversation readable even when the audience cannot hear the other person. Build specific listening beats, responses to new information, and a clear ending. This is character scene work, distinct from a recorded phone menu or voicemail greeting.
zhintro: 让观众在听不到电话另一端时也能理解单边虚构对话。建立具体倾听节拍、对新信息的反应以及清楚结尾；这是角色场景练习，不是录制菜单或留言问候。
drills: Other-side outline
Write a private outline of what the unseen speaker says. Each response should answer actual new information rather than a vague imaginary pause.
Listening beat
Perform the silent gap while keeping attention on the partner’s thought. Let the next line change because of what was heard rather than because a timer elapsed.
Partial repetition
Repeat only the detail the audience needs to follow the scene. Compare with a version that unnaturally repeats the unseen speaker’s entire sentence.
Interrupted sentence
Practice one interrupted line and a clear restart. The interruption should reveal new information, not simply add random pauses to every phrase.
Connection problem choice
Write a fictional moment of unclear reception. Show what the character heard and asks to repeat without pretending that the recording itself is technically broken.
Call ending
Give the character a concrete reason to finish. Record the closing and a moment after the call so the scene’s final decision remains understandable.
zhdrills: 另一端提纲
私下写出看不见的说话者内容，每次回应都针对真实新增信息，而非随意空等。
倾听节拍
在无声间隙关注搭档的思想，下一句因听到的信息改变，不因计时结束而改变。
部分复述
只重复观众理解所需细节，对比不自然地复述另一端整句的版本。
句中打断
练一次被打断与明确重启，打断应揭示新信息，不给每句随机加停顿。
信号问题选择
写一处虚构听不清，表现角色听到了什么及要求重复什么，不假装录音真的故障。
明确挂断
给角色结束通话的具体原因，录结尾与挂断后一刻，保留场景最后决定。
sample: Original scene: “I found the key. … Under the stairs? No, I was at the gate. … Wait—there are two keys? … Then I will bring both.” Private partner notes: asks about stairs; explains two matching keys; requests both. Change the pauses according to those notes, keeping the audience able to follow the new information.
zhsample: 原创场景：“我找到钥匙了。……楼梯下面？不，我在门口。……等等，有两把？……那我都带来。”搭档私下提示：询问楼梯；解释两把相同钥匙；要求两把都带。根据提示调整停顿，让观众理解新信息。
review: Check that the audience infers the topic, recognizes the new information, hears a motivated interruption, follows the changed decision, and understands the ending. Reject a version in which all gaps have identical duration regardless of the unseen line. Review with someone who has not read the private partner notes.
zhreview: 观众能推知主题、辨认新信息、听出有原因的打断、跟上决定变化并理解结尾才通过。另一端内容不同但所有间隙一样长的版本应修正。请未读私下提示的人回听。
limit: Use fictional calls or authorized scene material. Do not record or disclose a real person’s private phone conversation for practice. The page does not make calls, simulate an actual caller, or provide a transcript of private communications.
zhlimit: 使用虚构电话或获授权场景，不为练习录制、披露他人私人通话。本页不拨打电话，不模拟真实来电者，也不提供私人通信转写。
